enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Axiomatic 6: On Hit: 6 to 24 Law damage. Law-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Chaotic user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Chaotic Outsider Bane 6: This weapon is designed specifically to hunt the unnatural that does not belong, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Chaotic Outsiders.
Seeker +14: Provides a +14 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +14 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Favored Weapon: This weapon has a divine attunement and gains bonuses as if it were a Favored Weapon regardless of your Deity.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
